Hanson Chiropractic and Injury is Everett's award winning Chiropractic and Injury center. Have you been in a car accident?  Have a work injury?  Back Pain?  We can help.  
New patients get a free 1 hour massage with your first visit.  When you need pain relief and injury care in Everett and Snohomish County we are here to help. 
https://everettpainrelief.com/
⭐Winner of Evening Magazine's Best of the Northwest Top Chiropractor  2012, 2013, 2015, 2015, 2016, 2017 
⭐Winner of Evening Magazine's Best of the Northwest Top Massage 2018
